column5: Swings the magic staff blindly. With more power\, she can somehow make the swings bigger.
Flips the magic staff upward\, leaving dark trails. It's a simple move used to repel opponents mid-air.
Fires magical bullets to all direction. This is a very fast and strong move that can be used for countering\, however it requires her to be at full power to be fired.
Places an artificial moon on the spot. The moon will explode after some time. You can hold the button to place a pair instead.
Fires a basic laser beam. You can hold down the button to fire stronger beam\, but this requires her to be at full power.
Calls upon a burning comet. It's difficult to aim\, but it's very fast.
Attacks with a beam that can be aimed at the enemy's position or your own. You can control the beam's timing by holding the button down.
Summons a swarm of little suns and aims it to the enemy. This is a very consuming attack\, so it requires her to be at full power.
Warps through space by magic. However this is not teleportation\, so it's not instantaneous.
Captures the enemy in the air with magical energy. She continuously discharges more energy to harm the opponent and then slams them to the ground.
A supermassive sized attack. However\, it requires time to set up.
A projectile consisting of two satellites with a magical energy coursing between them. The satellites continue to spin\, so it has a rather complex attack pattern.
Fires a cluster of miniature stars. After advancing for a moment\, it splits and rotates for a while.
Flips the magic staff upward\, creating massive dark trails. It doesn't even look close to a comet\, but she insists that the name is suitable.
Opens a gate in the sky that shoots massively high power beam. As her trump card\, this requires her to spend all of her energy in one shot.
Opens a gap in the sky that shoots high powered beam. It's an autonomous attack\, so she can move before it ends.
Draws an abstract constellation by using artificial stars. After a certain amount of time passed\, these stars will explode.
Engulfs the field in darkness. During this situation\, she is capable of avoiding opponent's physical attacks as they are projectiles.
Uses her speed to do counter attacks. If she presses the    guard button\, she can expend one    card in her hand to counter the     attack. If she has enough cards\, shecan enter defense mode.
A supermassive sized attack. It aims the whole arena\, so it is impossible to miss.
Summons a miniature sun which actively shoots solar flares around it. The sun requires to be maintained manually\, so she cannot move during it.
Fires five satellites that creates a constellation of star. They encroach into the enemy\, all while continuously growing in size.
